title: Week Ahead — Week of Nov 2, 2026
html:
Links: SPY Watchlist Options Playbook Fed Tracker Federal Reserve

Bottom line

SPY closed Oct 30 at 755.72 (-1.8% day, -0.6% week). It is below its 20-day (770) and 50-day (767) and above its 200-day (726). Friday's tech rout (Intel -29%, Alphabet -12%, SMH -7%) pushed the VIX to about 22. The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28, and futures put ~70-85% odds on a December hike.

One thing that matters: SPY holding 752 (38.2%) and the 743-745 confluence zone. A reclaim of 763.5, then the 50-day at 767, would repair the chart. A close below 743 opens 734, then 722.

  • Big swing, Mar 30 low 626.11 to Oct 6 high 781.62: 23.6% 744.92 | 38.2% 722.21 | 50% 703.86 | 127.2% 823.92
